    (['!![0, 0, 0; 0, 0, -1; 0, 1, 0]', '(by ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num)'], False),

]
cases = CASES
instances = [kernel_instance(*c[0], proof=c[2] if len(c) > 2 else PROOF, edge=c[1]) for c in cases]
